data.name: 1 MONKEY LEFT
data.detailed_description:
You learned the rhyme when you were five.

The lab learned it too.

1 MONKEY LEFT is a physics-based cross-platform co-op

horror-comedy where five monkeys raid a decommissioned

research facility for the biggest payday of their lives —

while a nursery rhyme counts down the chaos.

Your job is simple:

Get in. Grab the high-value salvage. Reach the extraction

pod before the final verse plays.

Of course, nothing ever goes smoothly.

KEY FEATURES

🎵 The Rhyme Mechanic — Five verses. Eighteen minutes. Each

verse breaks the lab a little more, until the final one

triggers full purge protocol.

🌍 Full Cross-Platform Co-op — Five players, PC and console

in the same lobby. Squad up, lose your friends together.

🎤 Proximity Voice Chat — Scavenge, panic, shout warnings,

and listen to your crewmates scream from somewhere deep in

the nursery dark.

📦 Physics-Based Salvage — Rip machinery from walls. Drag

oversized loot through tight corridors. Decide what's worth

carrying — and what's about to get someone hurt.

⚡ Strategic Chaos — Manage your noise, your weight, your

nerves, and the rhyme itself. The lab keeps count.

But whatever you do, don't lose focus — because the rhyme

is older than you, and the lab knows every verse.

Five monkeys. Five verses. One nursery rhyme that's been

waiting.

Find out which verse takes you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD R9 380 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 5600 XT (6 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
